title: The Rogue Tesla Mechanic Resurrecting Salvaged Cars
summary: A Motherboard documentary on Rich, who buys wrecked Teslas, rebuilds them from salvaged parts and shares the process as Rich Rebuilds. It shows the obstacles to repairing cars Tesla won't service.
why: HN cites it in right-to-repair and EV battery discussions as an example of independent Tesla repair.

quote.text: showing the silliness he has to go through to be able to repair salvaged Teslas
